name: Zimbra Detection Suite
summary: FIM, web, authentication, account-takeover, administrative-change, SOAP, MTA and host-noise rules for Zimbra mail servers, with the decoders they need.
summary_zh: 針對 Zimbra 郵件伺服器的檔案完整性、Web、認證、帳號接管、管理變更、SOAP、MTA 與主機雜訊規則，並附上所需的解碼器。
author: Jason Tools
notes: zimbra-webfiles is the stock-file baseline. The shipped copy was generated from Zimbra 10.1.20 (FOSS and NETWORK editions combined) and is a starting point, not a substitute for generating your own.

Regenerate the baseline after every Zimbra install AND after every upgrade - an upgrade replaces version-stamped jars, and each new filename is unknown to the old baseline. Generate with: { find /opt/zimbra/jetty_base/webapps -type f \( -name '*.jsp' -o -name '*.jspx' -o -name '*.jar' -o -name '*.class' -o -name '*.war' -o -name '*.html' \); find /opt/zimbra/lib/ext -type f; } | sort -u | sed 's/$/:legit/'   -- note that lib/ext takes ALL file types, not just jars: rule 100806 alerts on any file there, and .wsdl, .xsd and .properties files live in it.

Private addresses (10/8, 172.16/12, 192.168/16, 127/8, 100.64/10, fc00::/7, fe80::/10) are written into the rules, so the pack is quiet and useful on a fresh install with every list left as shipped. etc/lists/zimbra-internal-networks is optional tuning: an address listed there is never treated as external, for an office NAT address or a proxy with a public address. ::1 is deliberately not in the rules: a negated ::1 in 4.14.7 also excludes every IPv4 address.
The agent's syscheck must monitor the Zimbra directories with whodata=yes for the writing process to be recorded.

The stock baseline does not include WEB-INF/lib/*.jar or lib/ext. Those paths are the usual source of false positives on rules 100803 and 100806; regenerating the baseline fixes it at the source, which is better than suppressing the alerts.

Hash matching on file integrity events is provided by the jt-malware-hash pack, rule 100141, against a list rebuilt nightly. This pack no longer ships a hash list of its own: the one it had contained a single placeholder, so the level 15 rule reading it had never fired.

Rule 100807 was one rule covering every extension from jsp to elf, and it did not look at the file mode. Measured over fifteen days on a development host it produced 6,133 alerts at level 12, of which 5,538 were .py files, most of them source code with no execute bit that could never have been run. It is now split by whether the extension needs that bit: 100807 keeps the web application artefacts, which a container loads regardless of mode, and 100809 takes the scripts and binaries and requires the execute bit. Verified: a .py at 0755 matches 100809, the same file at 0644 is silent. Rule 100810 then excludes build and test toolchain scratch directories, which produced 399 of these alerts in a single day on a build host.

Rule 100808 (a stock file's contents rewritten, level 13) could never fire before 2.7: its sibling 100800 claimed the event first and 100801 settled every stock-file change at level 0. 100801 now takes only changes that leave the contents alone, and 100808 takes the rest, in the web directories and lib/ext alike. Expect a batch of these on every Zimbra upgrade, which rewrites stock files; regenerate the baseline afterwards.

3.4: the generic Linux host rules are gone from this pack: 100936 (NOPASSWD: ALL added), 100937 (package-manager writes), 100938 (PAM), 100939 (sudo), 100940 (cron), 100941 (systemd units) and 100942 (authorized_keys). They applied to every Linux agent, not only Zimbra servers, and each covered part of its area (cron.weekly, /etc/crontab, at, user units, PAM modules and the account databases were never seen). The jt-linux-integrity pack replaces them with wider coverage and levels that depend on which program wrote the file. Install it to keep the coverage; until then these changes fall back to the built-in rules 550, 553 and 554 (levels 5 to 7). A site rule that is a child of one of those IDs no longer loads.

3.0 ships the decoders. Before 3.0 the rules named three decoders the pack did not contain, so on a manager without a hand-made copy wazuh-analysisd refused the whole ruleset. The decoder files keep the names such copies had (0001-zimbra_decoders.xml, 0002-zimbra_mailbox_decoders.xml); installing over one replaces it and the installer keeps the original as a backup.

Measured on two Zimbra 10.1 servers over 41 days: about 105,000 alerts a day. 84,000 were Zimbra's own sudo and su housekeeping (zmmailboxdmgr status every few seconds, each with two PAM session lines), 17,000 one postdrop process stuck on a permission error, 1,300 two internal hosts refused for want of reverse DNS, 700 a monitoring check refused by sudo, 200 configuration files rewritten by zmconfigd, and the only mailed pack alerts (2.7 a day) were phones syncing through Z-Push. 3.0 handles each as a child of the rule that raised it and keeps one alert per real condition: replayed on the same alerts, about 1,700 a day remain, most of them from outside this pack (a refused SNMP sudo, netstat port changes, SCA results).

Rules that could never fire are fixed: the login-success, admin-login, cracked-password and multi-source rules (100845-100852; <action> compares as a plain string unless a type is given), the burst-of-mail rule (100925/100928) and the two-factor rule (100851), which looked in audit.log for lines it never contains, and the repeat rules 100825, 100826 and 100923, which counted only events that ended at their parent. 100849 and 100922 could report an internal admin login or export at level 14 and now require an external address; 100846 hung off every login rule in the ruleset (an SSH brute force was reported as Zimbra) and is now Zimbra-only.

Requests through a proxy (Z-Push, a reverse proxy) are attributed to the client the proxy reported, the first oip address, instead of decoding with no address and no account. The address is only as trustworthy as the proxy chain: where a proxy appends to a client-supplied X-Forwarded-For header instead of replacing it, the client can choose it.

With zimbraLogToSyslog set, mailbox and audit lines also arrive through syslog (programs zimbra_mailbox and zimbra_audit). Only the copies read from /opt/zimbra/log count; rules 100834 and 100839 drop the others. Counting both halved every threshold: a third of the old SOAP alerts came from the syslog copy, and the generic rule 2501 raised every copied login failure a second time.

New in 3.0: infected mail or spam sent by a local account (level 12), virus scanning failing (level 10), Postfix unable to deliver to the mailbox server, remote servers refusing this server's mail as spam, queue growth, service and disk status from zimbramon, opendkim key errors, admin-console changes and logins, an administrator taking over another account's session, account lockout, application passwords and mail-filter changes.

Left to others on purpose: SMTP AUTH password failures per address are the built-in Postfix rules 3332 and 3357 (Zimbra also writes each one to audit.log, where 3.3 records it at level 2 in 100999 and counts it per account in 100842-100844); LDAP (slapd) belongs to the jt-ucs pack; Z-Push devices to the jt-zpush pack; known-bad addresses to jt-ioc (the old 100991, which read jt-ioc's list, was removed in 3.0: without jt-ioc it was ignored with a warning, with it 906001 already covers it).

etc/lists/zimbra-service-accounts is optional tuning and ships with a placeholder that matches nothing. Nothing needs to be listed: an internal tool that reads a mailbox through a delegated administrator session is reported once (100897) instead of raising the bulk-reading rules. List an account only to quiet an archiver or probe that reads a lot with its own credentials.

Several 3.0 rules raise a condition that repeats every second until fixed once every six hours (attribute ignore). The window is per rule, not per host, and starts over when the manager restarts or reloads the ruleset. wazuh-logtest does not apply it; it was verified through analysisd itself.

Rules 100860-100865 need an auditd rule file with the zimbra_* keys and rules 100880-100902 and 100992 need state-audit scripts writing /var/log/zimbra-state-audit.json. Neither ships with this pack; without them those rules stay silent.

3.1 applies one policy to every successful login, with no site data: an ordinary account from a private address is level 2 (recorded, no alert), and level 3 only the first time that (account, address) pair is seen; from a public address level 2, and level 5 the first time for the pair; an administrator-class login (the admin SOAP endpoint, cmd=AdminAuth, or the built-in names admin@, administrator@, root@) is level 3 from a private address and 8 from a public one; a success after repeated failures is 14 from the same address and 11 for the same account. Public addresses are level 5 only for a new pair because Z-Push logs in on every request it relays: measured 435 such logins a day, 2.4 new pairs a day.

First-seen pairs are remembered by the manager (fts) per agent, so a fresh install reports each existing (account, address) pair once in its first days: on the two measured servers about 40 alerts at level 3 or 5 in the first week, then about one a day. A phone or a monitoring probe produces one alert per address, ever.

Mailbox reading through a delegated administrator session from a private address is not counted by the bulk-reading rules 100972/100973 any more: it is reported the first time for each (administrator, mailbox, address) triple at level 5 (100897), and an administrator starting on five different mailboxes within an hour raises level 12 (100899). Measured: one internal tool read 1,788 messages of one mailbox in 8.8 days; 3.0 raised 1.3 level 12-14 alerts a day for it unless its account was listed, 3.1 raises one level 5 alert, ever. From a public address such reads are still counted.

100852 (one account from several public addresses, level 13) now counts first-seen public pairs. In 3.0 it used different_srcip, which in 4.14.7 counts earlier events whose address differs from the current one, not distinct addresses: two logins from one address and one from a second already counted as three sources, so a phone changing its mobile address within an hour would have raised it.

preauth logins (an SSO integration logs in every user this way) are recorded at level 2 instead of level 13 each; that preauth is in use is raised at most once a day at level 10 (100831), and preauth into an administrator account at level 12 every time (100832).

3.2 gives failed logins a decoder of their own (zimbra-audit-fail), so password spraying (100843/100836) counts distinct accounts and distributed guessing (100844) distinct addresses: both count the first failure of each (account, address) pair (100811, first-time-seen). In 3.1 they used different_user and different_srcip, which in Wazuh 4.14.7 count earlier events whose value differs from the current one: seven failures of one account and one of another from a shared address raised level 12 (verified in a sandbox). A pair counts once, ever; the volume rule 100842 (12 failures in 5 minutes from one address) still counts every failure.

Failures for accounts that do not exist were invisible. Zimbra writes them without cmd= ("Error occurred during authentication: authentication failed for [x]. Reason: account not found.", service/account/Auth.java) and only when the localconfig key zimbra_additional_logging is true, which is not the default. 3.2 decodes that line as a failure, so guessed account names count towards spraying; turning the key on is an optional setup step.

Zimbra's own lockout record (error=account lockout due to too many failed logins) is now always level 10 (100856). In 3.1 it competed with the plain failure rules and could come out at level 5 or 6, and the test for it used a line shape Zimbra never writes.

Administrative changes are reported for the first time. Zimbra writes every directory change made through the admin interfaces (admin console, zmprov without -l, any admin token) to audit.log with the attributes it changed; in 3.1 they all ended at level 0. Now: any change level 3 (100908), account, domain and configuration lifecycle 5 (100918), zimlets and delegated-admin constraints 8 (100916), forwarding set by an administrator 10 (100914), a password reset of an administrator-class account 10 (100915), a domain preauth key 10 (100913), administrator rights granted 12 (100910), MTA trusted networks opened to every address 12 (100911), any change from a public address 12 (100912/100919). Lines that carry a credential (preauth key, bind passwords, secrets) are reported without the log line. Measured: none in 9 days on two servers. Zimbra does not log GrantRight/RevokeRight or zmprov -l, so those stay invisible.

SMTP command injection: an address containing $(, ${ or a backtick in any Postfix line is level 13 (100980), a forged "Service status change:" record inside a Postfix line level 14 (100986), and the same in an amavis line 13 (100987). These are CVE-2026-73570 (swatchdog SNMP notification, CISA KEV, fixed in 10.1.20) and CVE-2024-45519 (postjournal, KEV): the attacker's address is written to /var/log/zimbra.log even when Postfix rejects it. Only zmconfigd writes that status line legitimately. Measured: no address containing those characters in 171,515 Postfix lines in 7 days.

Web: a JSP outside /public/ that Zimbra does not ship (100988, level 10 when it answers, 14 for 200/302 in 100989), a JSP called with a system path or a Zimbra command in its query (100993, the CISA AA22-228A shape, 14), the ClientUploader upload endpoint (100994) and the WebEx zimlet SSRF CVE-2020-7796 (100995) at 12, reflected cross-site scripting shapes on the Classic client and public JSPs (100996, 10), and an exploit URL answered with 404, the endpoint not existing here (100997, 8 instead of 12-14). Path traversal (100976) is case-insensitive now and catches ..;/ and encoded forms; a 401 from mboximport still counts, because the exploit wrote its shell while returning 401.

Bugs fixed: the stock-JSP list (100822) missed the PDF viewer, admin.jsp, noscript.jsp and proto/index.jsp, so a user opening a PDF attachment raised 100823 at level 14 (seen on a real server); 100827 (admin interface) and its level 0 child silenced a web shell under /zimbraAdmin/ opened from a private address, and reported it as an admin login from a public one; 100979 (a file written into the web root by a mail-handling process, the CVE-2022-41352 class) could never fire, because its level 15 sibling 100803 loaded first and took the same events (verified with a synthetic whodata event).

100800 (the base rule for file changes under the web root and lib/ext) and 100876 (configuration files rewritten unchanged) are level 1 instead of 0. Wazuh 4.14.7 tries a level 0 rule before all of its siblings, so they took FIM events in Zimbra paths before the hash-list rules beside them (jt-malware-hash 100141, built-in 99901) could look the file up: a known-malware file in a Zimbra directory was silent. Verified with synthetic FIM events in a sandbox: such a file now ends at the hash rule (level 14), and every other event ends where it did. 100960 (timestomping) had never fired for the same reason; it now takes only a non-stock executable file in the web root whose only change is its modification time.

sudo: zmconfigd rewrites Postfix settings on every configuration pass, and 3.1 left those that Postfix later executes from visible. 3.2 quiets them only when the value is Zimbra's stock value (the /opt/zimbra paths, ldap-transport.cf, amavis on 127.0.0.1:10024, the milter on 127.0.0.1:7026, postfix/postdrop, empty values): about 52 visible alerts a day on two measured servers. Any other value stays visible. always_bcc, sender_bcc_maps, recipient_bcc_maps and smtpd_proxy_filter set through sudo copy or divert every message and are level 12 (100804).

Account takeover: a mail filter (now level 7), sending identity (3) or preference change (2, recorded) by an account within 30 minutes of its first login from a public address it had never used is level 12 (100816), the shape of the CVE-2025-27915 and CVE-2023-37580 payloads and of a phished password. A phone saving its settings through Z-Push is not counted. The window is in practice as long as the manager's correlation memory (8,192 events).

Logins: SSOAuth (SAML, JWT, SPNEGO) now follows the login policy; a login with a password-reset recovery code is level 5 (100812); a lockout lifted by a successful login is level 3 (100813); ZimbraInvalidLoginFilter suspending an address is level 8 (100818, at most once every 30 minutes, each refused request recorded at level 2).

File integrity: the zimbra group monitors /etc/pam.d, /etc/sudoers and /etc/sudoers.d with whodata and report_changes, and cron and /etc/systemd/system with the same options as the jt-linux-integrity group (3.4: report_changes added, so a server in both groups gets the same configuration whichever group the agent reads last; at job files get no diff, they hold the user's environment). The rules that read these files are in jt-linux-integrity since 3.4: there a change by an unknown writer is level 10, by a program other than the package manager 12, an added "NOPASSWD: ALL" or a PAM bypass line 14. These are the persistence steps reported after CVE-2026-73570 exploitation (a pam_exec hook in /etc/pam.d/sudo, NOPASSWD: ALL for the zimbra account). Zimbra's installer rewrites its sudoers file on upgrade, so expect one such alert then.

100963 re-levels the built-in 503 (agent started) and 504 (agent disconnected) for every agent, not only Zimbra servers. It is level 5 instead of 14 and no longer mentions Zimbra; measured 3 to 36 a day on one manager, mostly a laptop going to sleep. The ID and parents stay, because site rules may count it.

Versions: decoders and rules follow the Zimbra 10.1.20 source (zm-mailbox, tag 10.1.20); the audit and mailbox log layout has not changed since 8.8.15. mboximport (backup extension) and the two-factor operations exist only in the Network edition; ClientUploader was removed in 10.0.1. Not covered because no log line shows them: SMTP smuggling (CVE-2023-51764), the memcache injection CVE-2022-27924, and amavis archive extraction (CVE-2022-41352 is covered through file integrity).

3.3 reads every field from its own place in the line. A Zimbra log line is date, level, [thread], [context], logger, message; the thread carries the request URL and the context the client's user agent, both chosen by the client, and 3.2 took the first "oip=", "ua=", "name=" or "security - cmd=" anywhere. Verified in the sandbox: a request to ".../AuthRequest?x=;oip=192.0.2.250;" was decoded with that address as the source, so the brute-force rules and the opt-in firewall-drop on them could be aimed at any address; and a successful login whose user agent contained "] security - cmd=Auth; error=x; account=admin@..." became a failed login of another account, which hid a guessed password from the "success after failures" rules. Zimbra doubles every ";" inside a value, so the decoders now walk the context pair by pair and read the message after it.

A Zimbra tool user agent (zmprov, zmmailbox, ZCS) no longer silences anything by itself: until 3.2 a login, a mailbox read or a filter or identity change sent with "User-Agent: ZCS" was treated as Zimbra talking to itself, a stolen password included. Now only Zimbra's built-in "zimbra" account (name=zimbra, or aname=zimbra for a delegated session) from no address or a private one counts as the tool. Measured on two servers over ten days: every zm*/ZCS session was exactly that, so the change adds no alerts there.

Cross-pack login groups (for the jt-account-guard pack): every rule a successful login can end at carries jt_auth_success (100845, 100812, 100847, 100848, 100849, 100854, 100837, 100838, 100846, 100833, 100852, 100850, 100831, 100832, 100998), every rule a failed attempt can end at jt_auth_failure (100841, 100857, 100811, 100999, 100842, 100859, 100843, 100836, 100844, 100991), and Zimbra locking an account or suspending an address jt_auth_lockout (100856, 100805, 100818). srcip is the client, dstuser the account. One copy per attempt: the syslog copies, the mailbox.log copy of a SOAP failure and Zimbra's own tools end at level 0. DelegateAuth is not a login of the account it names and is not tagged.

SMTP AUTH: Postfix authenticates through saslauthd, which asks Zimbra, so one wrong password is written by Postfix (built-in 3332, level 5; 3357 for eight from one address in two minutes) and in audit.log. 3.3 records the audit.log copy at level 2 (100999, still counted per account and per address) except the first failure of each (account, address) pair, which keeps naming the account at level 5 (100811). New: a login from an address Postfix had just reported for repeated SMTP AUTH failures is level 14 (100998); those failures reach audit.log only for accounts that exist, so a spray of guessed names could end in a correct guess that no Zimbra rule had counted.

Second factor: after a correct password Zimbra asks for a code, and audit.log has already logged the password step as a success; a wrong code appears only in mailbox.log ("SoapEngine - handler exception: authentication failed for [x], invalid two-factor code", or "invalid TOTP code" while setting it up). That is level 5 (100991), a failed login, and counts for brute force from one address (twelve in five minutes, 100842/100859). Two-factor exists in the Network Edition and the open-source zimbra-maldua-2fa extension. The same mailbox.log line for a wrong password was raised by the built-in 2501 at level 5 next to 100841 for every failed web or SOAP login; 3.3 decodes it and keeps it at level 0 (100990).

Account takeover: 100816 (level 12, a change within 30 minutes of an account's first login from a new public address) now also follows a password change, two-factor turned off, backup codes or an application password created, and a new recovery address or delegated rights (100935, level 5 on its own: SetRecoveryAccountRequest, whoever reads the recovery mailbox can reset the password; GrantRightsRequest, send-as, send-on-behalf-of and calendar rights). The web client's own mailbox export (/home/<account>/?fmt=tgz, without /service) was never matched by 100920-100923; it is now, and a Briefcase multi-file download is not. Not detectable from the logs Zimbra writes at its default level: who a folder was shared with (FolderActionRequest names no grantee), bulk IMAP or POP downloads (FETCH and RETR are not logged), and whether a login used an application password.

SMTP AUTH session tokens: on a default Zimbra install saslauthd logs, at debug level and into /var/log/zimbra.log, the whole answer Zimbra gives it for every SMTP AUTH, including a session token valid for two days (found in the measured site's central log store for every SMTP AUTH). The zimbra group now has the agent skip those lines, so the tokens no longer reach the manager or its archives; the setup step shows how to stop them being written at all.

The rule-ID range 100800-100999 is now full: 3.3 uses the last free IDs (100935, 100998, 100999 and the IDs of rules removed in 3.0 and earlier, 100990 and 100991, now different rules in 08-zimbra_soap_rules.xml). A site rule that referred to the removed ones would now refer to the new rules.

3.5: a stale web-file baseline is reported. 100802 (level 14) relies on etc/lists/zimbra-webfiles, and every Zimbra upgrade renames the version-stamped jars; one server ran 10.1.21 for eight weeks against a 10.1.20 list, so each permission change to its own jars raised 100802 and nothing said the list was out of date. jt-zimbra-baseline-check.py (manager, every six hours, every cluster node) compares each Zimbra server's release from the package inventory with the releases the list covers: 133301 (level 10, mailed, weekly reminder) when it is not covered, 133302 when it is again, 133304 (level 10, mailed) when the list cannot be read, 133306 when the inventory cannot. jt-zimbra-baseline.sh builds the list from the package database instead of the disk and writes the release markers. The pack now has a second rule ID block, 133300-133399, because 100800-100999 is full.
notes_zh: zimbra-webfiles 是原廠檔案基線。隨附的版本產生自 Zimbra 10.1.20（FOSS 與 NETWORK 版聯集），是起點而非自行產生的替代品。

每次 Zimbra 安裝後**與每次升級後**都要重建基線 —— 升級會替換帶版本號的 jar，新檔名對舊基線來說是未知的。產生方式：{ find /opt/zimbra/jetty_base/webapps -type f \( -name '*.jsp' -o -name '*.jspx' -o -name '*.jar' -o -name '*.class' -o -name '*.war' -o -name '*.html' \); find /opt/zimbra/lib/ext -type f; } | sort -u | sed 's/$/:legit/''   注意 lib/ext 要收「所有」檔案型別而非只有 jar：規則 100806 對該目錄下任何檔案都告警，而 .wsdl / .xsd / .properties 都在裡面。

私有位址（10/8、172.16/12、192.168/16、127/8、100.64/10、fc00::/7、fe80::/10）已寫進規則，所以全新安裝、所有清單維持原樣時，套件就能保持安靜而且有用。etc/lists/zimbra-internal-networks 是選用的調校：列在裡面的位址永遠不會被當成外部來源，適用於辦公室 NAT 位址或擁有公開位址的代理。規則刻意不含 ::1：在 4.14.7 中，否定的 ::1 也會排除所有 IPv4 位址。
agent 端 syscheck 需以 whodata=yes 監控 Zimbra 目錄才能取得寫入程序資訊。
原廠基線未含 WEB-INF/lib/*.jar 與 lib/ext，這是 100803 / 100806 誤報的主要來源；重建基線可從源頭解決，優於用抑制規則掩蓋。
檔案完整性事件的雜湊比對由 jt-malware-hash 套件的規則 100141 提供，比對的是每晚重建的清單。本套件不再自帶雜湊清單：原本那份只有一個佔位符，讀取它的 level 15 規則從未觸發過。

規則 100807 原本是一條涵蓋 jsp 到 elf 全部副檔名、而且不看檔案權限的規則。在一台開發主機上實測 15 天產生 6,133 筆 level 12，其中 5,538 筆是 .py，多數是沒有執行權限位元的原始碼，根本不可能被執行。現在依「這個副檔名要不要 x 位元」拆開：100807 留下由容器載入、不看權限的網頁應用產物，100809 收下腳本與二進位檔並要求執行權限位元。實測：0755 的 .py 命中 100809，同一個檔案 0644 時靜默。規則 100810 再排除建置與測試工具鏈的暫存目錄 —— 在一台建置主機上，那類目錄一天就貢獻了其中 399 筆。
規則 100808（原廠檔案內容被改寫，level 13）在 2.7 之前不可能觸發：同層的 100800 先接走事件，其子規則 100801 又把所有原廠檔案變更定為 level 0。現在 100801 只收內容沒變的變動，其餘交給 100808，網站目錄與 lib/ext 都適用。Zimbra 每次升級都會改寫原廠檔案，會出現一批這條告警；升級後請重新產生基準清單。

3.4：本套件移除了通用的 Linux 主機規則：100936（新增 NOPASSWD: ALL）、100937（套件管理程式寫入）、100938（PAM）、100939（sudo）、100940（cron）、100941（systemd 單元）與 100942（authorized_keys）。它們套用在每一台 Linux agent，而不只 Zimbra 伺服器，而且每一條只涵蓋該領域的一部分（cron.weekly、/etc/crontab、at、使用者層級單元、PAM 模組與帳號資料庫從來看不到）。jt-linux-integrity 套件以更廣的範圍、並依寫入檔案的程式決定等級來取代它們。請安裝它以維持涵蓋範圍；在那之前這些變更會退回內建規則 550、553、554（level 5 到 7）。站台規則若是這些 ID 的子規則，將不再被載入。
3.0 起隨附解碼器。3.0 之前規則引用了三個套件裡沒有的解碼器，在沒有手動副本的管理端上 wazuh-analysisd 會拒絕載入整個規則集。解碼器檔名沿用這類副本的名稱（0001-zimbra_decoders.xml、0002-zimbra_mailbox_decoders.xml），安裝時會取代它，安裝程式會保留原檔備份。

在兩台 Zimbra 10.1 伺服器上實測 41 天：每天約 105,000 筆告警。其中 84,000 筆是 Zimbra 自己透過 sudo 與 su 做的例行工作（每隔幾秒一次 zmmailboxdmgr status，每次再加兩行 PAM 工作階段），17,000 筆是一個卡在權限錯誤的 postdrop 程序，1,300 筆是兩台缺少反解的內部主機被拒收，700 筆是被 sudo 拒絕的監控檢查，200 筆是 zmconfigd 改寫設定檔，而本套件唯一會寄信的告警（每天 2.7 筆）全是手機經 Z-Push 同步。3.0 對每一項都以「引發它的那條規則的子規則」處理，每個真實狀況保留一則告警：用同一批告警重放，每天剩約 1,700 筆，多數來自本套件以外（被拒的 SNMP sudo、netstat 連接埠變化、SCA 結果）。

修正了不可能觸發的規則：登入成功、管理員登入、密碼被破解與多來源登入（100845-100852；<action> 未指定 type 時是逐字比對），以及到 audit.log 找它根本不會寫的內容的大量寄信（100925/100928）與兩步驟驗證（100851），還有只計入「最後停在父規則」事件的重複類規則 100825、100826、100923。100849 與 100922 可能把內部的管理員登入或匯出報成 level 14，現在要求外部來源；100846 原本掛在整個規則集的所有登入規則下（SSH 暴力破解會被報成 Zimbra），現在只看 Zimbra。
經代理（Z-Push、反向代理）進來的請求，現在記在代理回報的用戶端，也就是 oip 的第一個位址；原本這類記錄解不出位址也解不出帳號。這個位址的可信度取決於代理鏈：代理若是附加在用戶端自帶的 X-Forwarded-For 之後而不是取代它，用戶端就能自己指定這個位址。

設定 zimbraLogToSyslog 時，mailbox 與 audit 的記錄也會經 syslog 進來（程式名 zimbra_mailbox、zimbra_audit）。只有從 /opt/zimbra/log 讀到的那份會被計數，規則 100834 與 100839 會丟掉另一份。兩份都算會讓每個門檻減半：舊的 SOAP 告警有三分之一來自 syslog 副本，通用規則 2501 也會把每筆複製來的登入失敗再報一次。

第一次出現的組合由管理端記住（fts），以 agent 為單位，所以全新安裝後的頭幾天，每一組既有的（帳號、位址）都會回報一次：在兩台實測伺服器上，第一週約 40 則 level 3 或 5，之後每天約一則。手機或監控探針每個位址只會有一則告警，永遠如此。

從私有位址透過管理員委派工作階段讀取信箱，不再計入大量讀信規則 100972/100973：每一組（管理員、信箱、位址）第一次出現時以 level 5 回報（100897），管理員在一小時內開始讀取五個不同的信箱則是 level 12（100899）。實測：一個內部工具在 8.8 天內讀了同一個信箱 1,788 封信；3.0 若不把它的帳號列入，每天會產生 1.3 則 level 12-14 告警，3.1 只會產生一則 level 5，永遠如此。從公開位址的這類讀取仍會計數。

preauth 登入（SSO 整合會用這種方式登入每一位使用者）改為每筆 level 2 記錄，不再是每筆 level 13；「伺服器正在使用 preauth」這件事每天最多以 level 10 回報一次（100831），以 preauth 登入管理員帳號則每次都是 level 12（100832）。

不存在的帳號登入失敗原本完全看不到。Zimbra 寫這種記錄時不用 cmd= 格式（「Error occurred during authentication: authentication failed for [x]. Reason: account not found.」，service/account/Auth.java），而且只在 localconfig 的 zimbra_additional_logging 為 true 時才寫，預設不是。3.2 把這一行當成失敗解碼，猜測的帳號名稱也會計入密碼噴灑；開啟這個設定是選用的部署步驟。

管理變更第一次被回報。透過管理介面（管理主控台、不帶 -l 的 zmprov、任何管理權杖）所做的目錄變更，Zimbra 都會連同變更的屬性寫進 audit.log；3.1 時這些全部停在 level 0。現在：任何變更 level 3（100908），帳號、網域與設定的建立刪除修改 5（100918），zimlet 與委派管理限制 8（100916），管理者設定轉寄 10（100914），重設管理類帳號的密碼 10（100915），網域 preauth 金鑰 10（100913），授予管理者權限 12（100910），MTA 信任網段開放給所有位址 12（100911），任何變更來自公開位址 12（100912/100919）。帶有憑證的記錄（preauth 金鑰、繫結密碼、密鑰）回報時不附記錄原文。實測兩台伺服器 9 天內沒有任何一筆。Zimbra 不記錄 GrantRight/RevokeRight 與 zmprov -l，這兩者仍然看不到。

SMTP 指令注入：任何 Postfix 記錄中的郵件位址含有 $(、${ 或反引號時為 level 13（100980），Postfix 記錄中出現偽造的「Service status change:」為 level 14（100986），amavis 記錄中出現同樣內容為 13（100987）。對應 CVE-2026-73570（swatchdog 的 SNMP 通知，CISA KEV，10.1.20 修正）與 CVE-2024-45519（postjournal，KEV）：即使 Postfix 拒收，攻擊者的位址仍會寫進 /var/log/zimbra.log。只有 zmconfigd 會合法寫出那一行狀態記錄。實測 7 天 171,515 行 Postfix 記錄中沒有任何位址含有這些字元。

Web：不是 Zimbra 原廠、位於 /public/ 以外的 JSP（100988，有回應時 level 10，回應 200/302 時 100989 為 14），查詢字串帶有系統路徑或 Zimbra 指令的 JSP（100993，CISA AA22-228A 的樣式，14），ClientUploader 上傳端點（100994）與 WebEx zimlet 的 SSRF CVE-2020-7796（100995）為 12，Classic 用戶端與公開 JSP 的反射型 XSS 樣式（100996，10），以及漏洞網址回應 404、表示這台沒有那個端點（100997，8，原本是 12 到 14）。路徑穿越（100976）改為不分大小寫，並涵蓋 ..;/ 與編碼形式；mboximport 回應 401 仍然算數，因為該漏洞在回應 401 的同時已寫入 web shell。

100963 改變的是內建 503（agent 啟動）與 504（agent 斷線）的等級，適用於所有 agent，不只 Zimbra 伺服器。現在是 level 5（原為 14），描述不再提到 Zimbra；實測一台管理端每天 3 到 36 筆，多半是筆電進入睡眠。規則 ID 與父規則不變，因為站台規則可能會計算它。

版本：解碼器與規則依據 Zimbra 10.1.20 原始碼（zm-mailbox，tag 10.1.20）；audit 與 mailbox 記錄格式自 8.8.15 起未變。mboximport（備份擴充）與兩步驟驗證操作只存在於 Network 版；ClientUploader 在 10.0.1 移除。沒有任何記錄行能看出、因此未涵蓋的：SMTP smuggling（CVE-2023-51764）、memcache 注入 CVE-2022-27924，以及 amavis 解壓縮（CVE-2022-41352 由檔案完整性涵蓋）。

3.3 起每個欄位都從它在記錄中的固定位置讀取。Zimbra 的記錄依序是時間、等級、[執行緒]、[情境]、記錄器、訊息；執行緒名稱帶著請求網址，情境帶著用戶端的 User-Agent，兩者都由用戶端決定，而 3.2 抓的是整行中第一個出現的「oip=」「ua=」「name=」或「security - cmd=」。沙箱實測：對「.../AuthRequest?x=;oip=192.0.2.250;」的請求會被解成以該位址為來源，暴力破解規則與掛在上面的選用 firewall-drop 因此可以被指向任何位址；User-Agent 含「] security - cmd=Auth; error=x; account=admin@...」的成功登入會變成另一個帳號的失敗登入，猜中的密碼就躲過「失敗後成功」規則。Zimbra 會把值裡的每個「;」重複一次，所以解碼器現在逐一走過情境裡的鍵值對，並只讀情境之後的訊息。

Zimbra 工具的 User-Agent（zmprov、zmmailbox、ZCS）不再單獨決定是否靜音：到 3.2 為止，帶「User-Agent: ZCS」的登入、讀信或篩選器與身分變更都被當成 Zimbra 自己的工具，包括拿偷來的密碼登入。現在只有 Zimbra 內建的「zimbra」帳號（name=zimbra，或委派工作階段的 aname=zimbra）、且沒有位址或來自私有位址，才算工具。兩台伺服器十天的實測：所有 zm*/ZCS 工作階段都正是如此，因此這項變更在那裡不會多出任何告警。

跨套件登入群組（供 jt-account-guard 套件使用）：成功登入可能停在的每條規則都帶 jt_auth_success（100845、100812、100847、100848、100849、100854、100837、100838、100846、100833、100852、100850、100831、100832、100998），失敗嘗試可能停在的每條規則都帶 jt_auth_failure（100841、100857、100811、100999、100842、100859、100843、100836、100844、100991），Zimbra 鎖定帳號或暫停位址帶 jt_auth_lockout（100856、100805、100818）。srcip 是用戶端，dstuser 是帳號。每次嘗試只算一份：syslog 副本、SOAP 失敗在 mailbox.log 的副本與 Zimbra 自己的工具都停在 level 0。DelegateAuth 不是它所指帳號的登入，不加標記。

SMTP AUTH：Postfix 透過 saslauthd 向 Zimbra 驗證，所以一次錯誤密碼會由 Postfix 記一次（內建 3332，level 5；同一位址兩分鐘內八次為 3357），audit.log 也記一次。3.3 把 audit.log 那份以 level 2 記錄（100999，仍依帳號與位址計數），只有每個（帳號, 位址）組合的第一次失敗維持 level 5（100811），因為只有它會寫出帳號。新增：Postfix 剛回報一再 SMTP AUTH 失敗的位址隨後登入成功，level 14（100998）；那些失敗只有在帳號存在時才會進 audit.log，所以用猜測帳號名稱的噴灑最後猜中，先前沒有任何 Zimbra 規則算過它。

第二因素：密碼正確後 Zimbra 才會要驗證碼，而 audit.log 已經把密碼這一步記成成功；驗證碼錯誤只出現在 mailbox.log（「SoapEngine - handler exception: authentication failed for [x], invalid two-factor code」，設定時則是「invalid TOTP code」）。這是 level 5（100991），算一次登入失敗，也計入同一位址的暴力破解（五分鐘十二次，100842/100859）。兩步驟驗證存在於 Network Edition 與開源的 zimbra-maldua-2fa 擴充。同一種 mailbox.log 記錄在密碼錯誤時，過去每一次網頁或 SOAP 登入失敗都會被內建 2501 以 level 5 再報一次（與 100841 重複）；3.3 解碼它並停在 level 0（100990）。

帳號接管：100816（level 12，帳號第一次從新公開位址登入後 30 分鐘內的變更）現在也涵蓋改密碼、關閉兩步驟驗證、產生備用碼或應用程式密碼，以及新的復原位址或委派權限（100935，單獨為 level 5：SetRecoveryAccountRequest，能讀復原信箱的人就能重設密碼；GrantRightsRequest，代為寄件、代表寄件與行事曆權限）。網頁版自己的整個信箱匯出（/home/<帳號>/?fmt=tgz，沒有 /service）過去從未被 100920-100923 比對到，現在會；公文包多檔下載則不算。以 Zimbra 預設記錄等級無法偵測的：資料夾分享給誰（FolderActionRequest 不寫被授權者）、IMAP 或 POP 的大量下載（FETCH 與 RETR 不記錄）、登入是否用了應用程式密碼。

SMTP AUTH 工作階段權杖：預設安裝的 Zimbra，saslauthd 會以 debug 等級把每次 SMTP AUTH 時 Zimbra 的完整回應寫進 /var/log/zimbra.log，其中包括有效兩天的工作階段權杖（在實測站台的集中記錄庫中，每一次 SMTP AUTH 都有）。zimbra 群組現在讓 agent 略過這些行，權杖不再送到管理端或它的 archives；部署步驟說明如何讓它們根本不被寫出。
規則 ID 範圍 100800-100999 已用完：3.3 用掉了最後幾個空號（100935、100998、100999，以及 3.0 以前移除的 100990、100991，現在是 08-zimbra_soap_rules.xml 中的不同規則）。若站台規則曾引用被移除的那兩條，現在會指到新規則。

3.5：會回報過期的網站檔案基準清單。100802（level 14）依賴 etc/lists/zimbra-webfiles，而每次 Zimbra 升級都會改掉帶版本號的 jar 檔名；曾有一台伺服器以 10.1.21 搭配 10.1.20 的清單跑了八週，它自己的 jar 每次權限變動都觸發 100802，卻沒有任何東西指出清單已過期。jt-zimbra-baseline-check.py（管理端，每六小時，叢集每個節點）比對套件清單中每台 Zimbra 伺服器的版本與清單涵蓋的版本：不在清單內時觸發 133301（level 10，寄出，每週提醒），重新涵蓋時觸發 133302，清單讀不到時觸發 133304（level 10，寄出），套件清單讀不到時觸發 133306。jt-zimbra-baseline.sh 從套件資料庫而不是磁碟產生清單，並寫入版本標記。因 100800-100999 已用完，本套件新增第二段規則編號 133300-133399。

agent_group.name: zimbra
agent_group.description: Log collection the pack needs on the monitored host

setup.title: Install the pack and reload the ruleset on every node
setup.title_zh: 安裝套件並在所有節點重新載入規則集
setup.body: Install from this page, then use Reload Ruleset on the Rules tab. A cluster synchronises rule files but does not reload the workers.
setup.body_zh: 在本頁安裝後，到「規則」分頁按「重新載入規則集」。叢集只同步規則檔、不會重載 worker。

setup.title: Assign the Zimbra servers to the zimbra group
setup.title_zh: 把 Zimbra 伺服器加入 zimbra 群組
setup.body: The group collects the Zimbra logs (including /var/log/zimbra.log, where Postfix, amavis and zimbramon write), raises the agent's event queue so a Zimbra restart does not overflow it, and monitors the web root, extensions, configuration, cron, systemd and temporary directories. An existing group is never overwritten by the installer; compare it with the pack's copy. File-integrity and buffer settings apply after the agent restarts.
setup.body_zh: 群組會收集 Zimbra 記錄（包括 Postfix、amavis、zimbramon 寫入的 /var/log/zimbra.log），調大 agent 的事件佇列避免 Zimbra 重啟時溢出，並監控網站根目錄、擴充模組、設定、cron、systemd 與暫存目錄。已存在的群組不會被安裝程式覆蓋，請與套件版本比對。檔案完整性與緩衝設定要 agent 重啟後才生效。
setup.verify: After the agent restarts, grep -i 'duplicated\|buffer' /var/ossec/logs/ossec.log on the Zimbra server: a '(1958) ... duplicated' line only means the agent already read that file.
setup.verify_zh: agent 重啟後，在 Zimbra 伺服器上 grep -i 'duplicated\|buffer' /var/ossec/logs/ossec.log：出現「(1958) ... duplicated」只表示 agent 本來就有讀那個檔。

setup.title: auditd on the Zimbra servers (who wrote the file)
setup.title_zh: Zimbra 伺服器上的 auditd（記錄是誰寫入檔案）
setup.body: The group monitors the web root with whodata, which records the process and user that wrote a file. On Linux whodata needs auditd running; without it the agent falls back to ordinary real-time monitoring, and a web shell is reported with no writer. Install auditd before assigning the host, then restart the agent.
setup.body_zh: 群組以 whodata 監控網站根目錄，記錄寫入檔案的處理程序與使用者。Linux 上 whodata 需要 auditd；沒有時 agent 會退回一般即時監控，web shell 落地時看不到寫入者。請先安裝 auditd 再把主機加入群組，然後重啟 agent。
setup.code:
apt install auditd        # or: dnf install audit
systemctl enable --now auditd
/var/ossec/bin/wazuh-control restart
setup.verify: grep -i whodata /var/ossec/logs/ossec.log | tail  — expect no 'Who-data engine could not start' message.
setup.verify_zh: grep -i whodata /var/ossec/logs/ossec.log | tail —— 不應出現 who-data 引擎無法啟動的訊息。

setup.title: Regenerate the web-file baseline
setup.title_zh: 重新產生網站檔案基準清單
setup.body: etc/lists/zimbra-webfiles lists the files Zimbra itself ships; rule 100802 (level 14) treats any jsp, jar, class or war file under Zimbra's web directories that it does not list as a likely web shell. Regenerate it on every Zimbra server after every install and every upgrade (an upgrade renames the version-stamped jars), merge the outputs, copy the result to the manager (the master of a cluster) and reload the ruleset. 3.5: use jt-zimbra-baseline.sh, which the zimbra agent group delivers to /var/ossec/etc/shared/. It takes the list from the package database (dpkg -L or rpm -ql), not from the disk, so a web shell already present is not added; it leaves out packaged files whose content no longer matches the package and prints them, and it prints the files on disk that no package owns (third-party extensions in lib/ext, Zimbra's generated downloads page): review them, then run it again with --include-unpackaged to keep the ones you recognise. It also writes a marker key per Zimbra release (jt-zimbra-release/x.y.z), from which jt-zimbra-baseline-check.py on the manager knows what the list covers; that check raises 133301 (level 10, mailed) when a Zimbra server runs a release the list does not cover, weekly until the list is regenerated, and 133302 when it is.
setup.body_zh: etc/lists/zimbra-webfiles 列出 Zimbra 自帶的檔案；規則 100802（level 14）會把 Zimbra 網頁目錄下不在清單裡的 jsp、jar、class、war 檔當成疑似 web shell。每次安裝與升級後都要在每台 Zimbra 伺服器上重新產生（升級會改掉帶版本號的 jar 檔名），合併各台結果、複製到管理端（叢集的 master）並重新載入規則集。3.5：改用 jt-zimbra-baseline.sh，zimbra agent 群組會把它送到 /var/ossec/etc/shared/。它從套件資料庫（dpkg -L 或 rpm -ql）取清單，不是掃磁碟，所以產生當下已存在的 web shell 不會被收進去；內容與套件不符的套件檔案會被排除並列出；磁碟上不屬於任何套件的檔案（lib/ext 的第三方擴充、Zimbra 產生的下載頁）會列出來：確認後再加 --include-unpackaged 執行一次，把認得的收進清單。它也會為每個 Zimbra 版本寫一個標記鍵（jt-zimbra-release/x.y.z），管理端的 jt-zimbra-baseline-check.py 據此判斷清單涵蓋哪些版本：Zimbra 伺服器跑的版本不在清單內時觸發 133301（level 10，寄出），每週提醒直到重新產生，重新產生後觸發 133302。
setup.code:
# on each Zimbra server, as root
sh /var/ossec/etc/shared/jt-zimbra-baseline.sh -o /root/zimbra-webfiles
# review the files it lists as owned by no package, then if they are yours:
sh /var/ossec/etc/shared/jt-zimbra-baseline.sh -o /root/zimbra-webfiles --include-unpackaged
# on the manager (the master of a cluster): merge the servers' lists, install, reload
sort -u zimbra-webfiles.server1 zimbra-webfiles.server2 > /var/ossec/etc/lists/zimbra-webfiles
chown wazuh:wazuh /var/ossec/etc/lists/zimbra-webfiles; chmod 660 /var/ossec/etc/lists/zimbra-webfiles
setup.verify: /usr/bin/python3 /var/ossec/etc/jt-packs/bin/jt-zimbra-baseline-check.py --wazuh-path /var/ossec --list prints the releases the list covers and each Zimbra server's release; after the ruleset reload the next run raises 133302 for a server that was stale.
setup.verify_zh: /usr/bin/python3 /var/ossec/etc/jt-packs/bin/jt-zimbra-baseline-check.py --wazuh-path /var/ossec --list 會印出清單涵蓋的版本與每台 Zimbra 伺服器的版本；重新載入規則集後，原本過期的伺服器在下一次執行時會觸發 133302。

setup.title: Optional: list addresses that are internal although public
setup.title_zh: 選用：列出雖是公開位址但屬於內部的位址
setup.body: Private ranges are built into the rules. If an office NAT address or a proxy (Z-Push, a reverse proxy) has a public address, add it to etc/lists/zimbra-internal-networks and reload the ruleset: its logins and failures are then never treated as external, and the active responses never block it.
setup.body_zh: 私有網段已內建在規則中。若辦公室 NAT 位址或代理（Z-Push、反向代理）使用公開位址，請把它加入 etc/lists/zimbra-internal-networks 並重新載入規則集：它的登入與失敗就不會被當成外部來源，主動回應也不會封鎖它。

setup.title: Optional: list accounts that read a lot with their own credentials
setup.title_zh: 選用：列出以自己帳號大量讀信的帳號
setup.body: Not needed by default. One account per line, the full address, then reload the ruleset. Bulk reading by these accounts (100972/100973) stops alerting. A tool working through a delegated administrator session from a private address needs no entry.
setup.body_zh: 預設不需要。每行一個帳號，寫完整位址，然後重新載入規則集。這些帳號的大量讀信（100972/100973）不再告警。從私有位址透過管理員委派工作階段運作的工具不需要列入。

setup.title: Do not collect /var/log/mail.log as well as /var/log/zimbra.log
setup.body: On a Zimbra server both files receive the same Postfix lines, so every Postfix event arrives twice and every Postfix frequency rule fires at half its threshold. If the agent's own ossec.conf lists /var/log/mail.log, remove that localfile and restart the agent. Nothing changes on the mail server itself.
setup.body_zh: 在 Zimbra 伺服器上兩個檔會收到相同的 Postfix 記錄，每個 Postfix 事件都會進來兩次，Postfix 的頻率類規則等於門檻減半。若 agent 自己的 ossec.conf 列了 /var/log/mail.log，請移除該 localfile 並重啟 agent。郵件伺服器本身不需任何變更。

setup.title: Check an older zimbra group configuration for patterns that match nothing
setup.title_zh: 檢查舊版 zimbra 群組設定中永遠比對不到的樣式
setup.body: syscheck's restrict and <ignore type="sregex"> are OS_Match: only ^ $ | ! are special. A pattern written as a regular expression, such as restrict="\.(jsp|sh)$" or ^/opt/zimbra/conf/(ca|nginx/includes), matches nothing: the restricted directories report no file at all and the ignore excludes nothing. The pack's agent.conf uses the OS_Match form (.jsp$|.sh$).
setup.body_zh: syscheck 的 restrict 與 <ignore type="sregex"> 都是 OS_Match：只有 ^ $ | ! 是特殊字元。寫成正規表示式的樣式，例如 restrict="\.(jsp|sh)$" 或 ^/opt/zimbra/conf/(ca|nginx/includes)，永遠比對不到：受限目錄完全不會回報任何檔案，ignore 也排除不了任何東西。套件的 agent.conf 使用 OS_Match 寫法（.jsp$|.sh$）。

setup.title: 3.2: monitor PAM and sudo on the Zimbra servers
setup.title_zh: 3.2：在 Zimbra 伺服器上監控 PAM 與 sudo
setup.body: The pack's zimbra group adds /etc/pam.d, /etc/sudoers and /etc/sudoers.d to file integrity monitoring (whodata and report_changes; a few dozen small files without secrets). An update leaves a group you have changed as it is: then add the <directories> line from the pack's agent.conf to your copy. Restart the agents afterwards; the setting applies only after a restart, and synced in the agent list only means the file arrived.
setup.body_zh: 套件的 zimbra 群組新增監控 /etc/pam.d、/etc/sudoers 與 /etc/sudoers.d（whodata 與 report_changes；只有幾十個不含機密的小檔）。如果群組設定被你改過，更新不會取代它：請把套件 agent.conf 裡那一行 <directories> 加進你的版本。之後重啟 agent；設定要重啟後才生效，agent 清單顯示 synced 只代表檔案已送達。
setup.verify: After the restart, with jt-linux-integrity installed, change a comment in /etc/pam.d/sudo on a test server and look for rule 132972 (132970 without auditd), then restore the file.
setup.verify_zh: 重啟後（並已安裝 jt-linux-integrity），在測試伺服器上改動 /etc/pam.d/sudo 的一行註解，確認出現規則 132972（沒有 auditd 時為 132970），再把檔案改回來。

setup.title: Optional: log failed logins for accounts that do not exist
setup.title_zh: 選用：記錄不存在帳號的登入失敗
setup.body: By default Zimbra writes nothing to audit.log when someone tries an account name that does not exist, so guessing names is invisible. The localconfig key zimbra_additional_logging adds exactly that one line and nothing else in 10.1.20. zmlocalconfig --reload applies it without a restart; if your version does not accept --reload, zmmailboxdctl restart does (web mail, IMAP and POP are unavailable for about a minute). 3.3: that line prints the typed name as it was sent (String.format, not Zimbra's escaping), so a client may be able to put a line break in it and start a line of its own in audit.log. This was not tested on a live server; until it is, do not enable the block-zimbra-bruteforce active response on a server with this setting on.
setup.body_zh: 預設情況下，有人嘗試不存在的帳號名稱時 Zimbra 不會在 audit.log 寫任何東西，猜帳號因此完全看不到。localconfig 的 zimbra_additional_logging 在 10.1.20 只會多寫這一行，不影響其他記錄。zmlocalconfig --reload 不必重啟即可套用；若你的版本不接受 --reload，就用 zmmailboxdctl restart（網頁信箱、IMAP 與 POP 約有一分鐘無法使用）。3.3：那一行會把輸入的名稱原樣印出（String.format，沒有經過 Zimbra 的跳脫），用戶端可能可以在名稱裡放換行，在 audit.log 寫出自己的一行。尚未在實機上驗證；在驗證之前，開著這個設定的伺服器請不要啟用 block-zimbra-bruteforce 主動回應。
setup.verify: grep 'account not found' /opt/zimbra/log/audit.log after a test login with a made-up name; the alert is rule 100811.
setup.verify_zh: 用一個虛構的帳號名稱測試登入後，grep 'account not found' /opt/zimbra/log/audit.log；告警為規則 100811。

setup.title: Check exposure to CVE-2026-73570 (SNMP notifications)
setup.title_zh: 檢查 CVE-2026-73570（SNMP 通知）的曝險
setup.body: The swatchdog SNMP notification injection (CISA KEV) needs the optional zimbra-snmp package with SNMP notifications on, and is fixed in 10.1.20. Rules 100980/100986 report attempts either way. If the package is installed and the server is older than 10.1.20, upgrade, or remove zimbra-snmp, or turn the notifications off. These commands only read.
setup.body_zh: swatchdog 的 SNMP 通知注入（CISA KEV）需要安裝選用的 zimbra-snmp 套件並開啟 SNMP 通知，10.1.20 已修正。不論如何，規則 100980/100986 都會回報攻擊嘗試。若已安裝該套件且版本早於 10.1.20，請升級，或移除 zimbra-snmp，或關閉通知。以下指令只做讀取。
setup.code:
dpkg -l zimbra-snmp 2>/dev/null | tail -1   # or: rpm -q zimbra-snmp
su - zimbra -c 'zmcontrol -v; zmlocalconfig snmp_notify'

setup.title: 3.3: keep SMTP AUTH session tokens out of the logs
setup.title_zh: 3.3：別讓 SMTP AUTH 的工作階段權杖進到記錄
setup.body: Zimbra's saslauthd checks every SMTP AUTH password against Zimbra and logs the whole answer at debug level, including a session token valid for two days ("zmpost: url=... returned buffer->data=...<authToken>..."). Zimbra's rsyslog file sends auth.* to /var/log/zimbra.log, so every mail client that sends through SMTP AUTH leaves a usable token in that file and in anything that forwards it. The pack's zimbra group now tells the agent to skip those lines (<ignore> on the /var/log/zimbra.log localfile, agent 4.6 or later); an update does not change a group you have modified, so add that <ignore> line to your copy, and note that a /var/log/zimbra.log entry in the agent's own ossec.conf is read first and has no such filter. To stop the file itself receiving them, change auth.* to auth.info in Zimbra's rsyslog file and restart rsyslog: no mail service restarts; Zimbra may rewrite that file on an upgrade, so check it again afterwards. Tokens already written stay valid until they expire: where old copies were shipped elsewhere (a central syslog server, Wazuh archives with logall), delete them there.
setup.body_zh: Zimbra 的 saslauthd 每次 SMTP AUTH 都向 Zimbra 驗證密碼，並以 debug 等級記下整個回應，裡面包括有效兩天的工作階段權杖（「zmpost: url=... returned buffer->data=...<authToken>...」）。Zimbra 的 rsyslog 設定把 auth.* 寫進 /var/log/zimbra.log，所以每個透過 SMTP AUTH 寄信的郵件軟體都會在這個檔、以及任何轉送它的地方留下可用的權杖。套件的 zimbra 群組現在讓 agent 略過這些行（/var/log/zimbra.log 這個 localfile 上的 <ignore>，需要 4.6 以後的 agent）；更新不會改動你修改過的群組，請把那一行 <ignore> 加進你的版本，也請注意 agent 自己的 ossec.conf 若列了 /var/log/zimbra.log，會先讀那一份，而那一份沒有這個過濾。要讓檔案本身不再收到這些行，把 Zimbra rsyslog 設定裡的 auth.* 改成 auth.info 並重新啟動 rsyslog：郵件服務不需要重啟；Zimbra 升級時可能改寫這個檔，升級後請再檢查。已經寫出去的權杖在到期前仍然有效：舊的副本若曾送到別處（集中式 syslog、開了 logall 的 Wazuh archives），請在那裡刪除。
setup.code:
grep -c 'zmpost: .*authToken' /var/log/zimbra.log
grep -n '^auth' /etc/rsyslog.d/60-zimbra.conf
# then: sed -i 's/^auth\.\*\([[:space:]]\)/auth.info\1/' /etc/rsyslog.d/60-zimbra.conf && systemctl restart rsyslog
setup.verify: After an SMTP AUTH login, grep 'zmpost:' /var/log/zimbra.log finds no new line (rsyslog changed), or the manager's archives have none from this host (agent filter).
setup.verify_zh: SMTP AUTH 登入後，grep 'zmpost:' /var/log/zimbra.log 不再有新的行（已改 rsyslog），或管理端的 archives 沒有來自這台主機的這類記錄（agent 過濾）。

setup.title: 3.4: install jt-linux-integrity to keep the sudo, PAM, cron, systemd and SSH key rules
setup.title_zh: 3.4：安裝 jt-linux-integrity，以保留 sudo、PAM、cron、systemd 與 SSH 金鑰規則
setup.body: 3.4 removes rules 100936-100942 (sudo, NOPASSWD: ALL, PAM, cron, systemd units, authorized_keys, package-manager writes): they were generic Linux rules that applied to every agent. Install the jt-linux-integrity pack from this page and reload the ruleset; it covers the same files and more. Optionally assign Linux hosts, the Zimbra servers included, to its linux-integrity group as well (the zimbra group keeps monitoring its own files with the same options). Before updating, search your own rule files for if_sid, if_matched_sid or overwrite naming 100936-100942: such a rule no longer loads (analysisd warns that the signature was not found and drops it), so move it to the jt-linux-integrity rule that now handles the file, or delete it if jt-linux-integrity already does the same (dpkg-new and other transient names, .wants links and snap units are already quiet there).
setup.body_zh: 3.4 移除了規則 100936-100942（sudo、NOPASSWD: ALL、PAM、cron、systemd 單元、authorized_keys、套件管理程式寫入）：它們是套用在每一台 agent 的通用 Linux 規則。請從本頁安裝 jt-linux-integrity 套件並重新載入規則集；它涵蓋相同的檔案而且更多。也可以把 Linux 主機（包括 Zimbra 伺服器）加入它的 linux-integrity 群組（zimbra 群組會以相同選項繼續監控自己的檔案）。更新前，請在自己的規則檔中搜尋 if_sid、if_matched_sid 或 overwrite 指到 100936-100942 的規則：這類規則將不再載入（analysisd 會警告找不到該規則並略過它），請把它改掛到現在處理該檔案的 jt-linux-integrity 規則，或在 jt-linux-integrity 已經做了相同的事時刪除它（dpkg-new 等暫存檔名、.wants 連結與 snap 單元在那裡已經是安靜的）。
setup.verify: /var/ossec/bin/wazuh-analysisd -t prints no warning naming 100936-100942, and rule 132920 or 132970 appears after a test change to /etc/sudoers.d or /etc/pam.d.
setup.verify_zh: /var/ossec/bin/wazuh-analysisd -t 沒有提到 100936-100942 的警告，且在測試改動 /etc/sudoers.d 或 /etc/pam.d 後出現規則 132920 或 132970。

setup.title: 3.5: run the baseline check on every cluster node
setup.title_zh: 3.5：在叢集每個節點執行基準清單檢查
setup.body: Installing or updating the pack schedules jt-zimbra-baseline-check.py every six hours on this node. Each node keeps the package inventory of the agents connected to it and the script reads only its own agents, so copy it to every worker and add the same cron line there (the cluster copies the list, not the script). It reads wazuh-db with SELECT only, needs no network access and writes manager events (location jt-zimbra-baseline). The first run reports every Zimbra server once: 133301 when its release is not in the list, otherwise a level 2 record.
setup.body_zh: 安裝或更新套件時會在本節點排程每六小時執行 jt-zimbra-baseline-check.py。每個節點只保存連到自己的 agent 的套件清單，腳本也只讀自己的 agent，所以要把它複製到每個 worker 並加上同樣的排程（叢集會同步清單，不會同步腳本）。它只以 SELECT 讀 wazuh-db、不需要連網，寫入的是管理端自己的事件（location jt-zimbra-baseline）。第一次執行會把每台 Zimbra 伺服器各回報一次：版本不在清單內時觸發 133301，否則記一筆 level 2。
setup.verify: --list prints the releases the list covers and the Zimbra servers this node handles with their release.
setup.verify_zh: --list 會印出清單涵蓋的版本，以及本節點負責的 Zimbra 伺服器與其版本。

active_response.title: Block an external address that keeps failing to log in to Zimbra
active_response.title_zh: 封鎖一再登入 Zimbra 失敗的外部位址
active_response.body: Drops traffic from the source address on the Zimbra server for 10 minutes after repeated login failures (100859) or password spraying (100836) from a public address; private ranges are built into the rules and addresses listed in zimbra-internal-networks are never included. The address is the client Zimbra recorded, which for a request through Z-Push or a reverse proxy is the address that proxy reported: a block on the mail server then has no effect, because the connection comes from the proxy, and blocking belongs on the proxy or the edge firewall instead. Risks: a mobile carrier or office NAT address is shared by many people, who are all locked out together; if a proxy appends to a client-supplied X-Forwarded-For header, an attacker can choose the address and make you block someone else, including an administrator; a proxy with a public address that is not listed in zimbra-internal-networks would be blocked itself and cut off every user behind it (for Z-Push, every phone). Put such addresses in zimbra-internal-networks and in the manager's white_list first. fail2ban on the same server blocks with the same iptables: if it already has a Zimbra jail, leave this off and let the jt-fail2ban pack report its bans. 3.3: the blocked address is the oip= (or ip=) key of the Zimbra log context, read in place; before 3.3 a client could put ";oip=<address>;" in the request URL and have that address blocked instead of its own. With zimbra_additional_logging on, see the setup step about it first.
active_response.body_zh: 公開位址一再登入失敗（100859）或密碼噴灑（100836）時，在 Zimbra 伺服器上封鎖該來源 10 分鐘；私有網段已內建在規則中，列在 zimbra-internal-networks 的位址永遠不會被包含。這個位址是 Zimbra 記下的用戶端；經 Z-Push 或反向代理進來的請求，是代理回報的位址：此時在郵件伺服器上封鎖沒有效果，因為連線來自代理，應改在代理或邊界防火牆封鎖。風險：電信業者或辦公室的 NAT 位址由許多人共用，會一起被擋；代理若把位址附加在用戶端自帶的 X-Forwarded-For 之後，攻擊者可以指定位址，讓你去封鎖別人，包括管理者；使用公開位址、卻沒列入 zimbra-internal-networks 的代理本身會被封鎖，切斷它後面的所有使用者（Z-Push 就是所有手機）。請先把這類位址放進 zimbra-internal-networks 和管理端的 white_list。同一台伺服器上的 fail2ban 用的是同一套 iptables：如果它已經有 Zimbra 的 jail，請不要啟用這項，交給 jt-fail2ban 套件回報封鎖。3.3：封鎖的位址是 Zimbra 記錄情境裡的 oip=（或 ip=）鍵，就地讀取；3.3 以前，用戶端只要在請求網址放「;oip=<位址>;」，被封鎖的就會是那個位址而不是它自己。若開了 zimbra_additional_logging，請先看關於它的部署步驟。

active_response.title: Block an external address scanning Zimbra's web paths
active_response.title_zh: 封鎖掃描 Zimbra 網頁路徑的外部位址
active_response.body: Drops traffic from the source address on the Zimbra server for 10 minutes after 20 or more 404 responses in two minutes from a public address (private ranges and addresses listed in zimbra-internal-networks end at 100984/100985 instead, often a proxy carrying many clients). The address comes from Zimbra's own nginx log, so it is the connecting client; behind a reverse proxy with a public address, list that proxy. Risk: a shared NAT address, and a misbehaving client of a real user, are blocked for the 10 minutes.
active_response.body_zh: 公開位址在兩分鐘內出現 20 次以上 404 時，在 Zimbra 伺服器上封鎖該來源 10 分鐘（私有網段與列在 zimbra-internal-networks 的位址會停在 100984/100985，常是帶著許多用戶端的代理）。位址取自 Zimbra 自己的 nginx 記錄，也就是連線的用戶端；若前面有使用公開位址的反向代理，請把它列入清單。風險：共用的 NAT 位址，以及真實使用者行為異常的用戶端，會被封鎖 10 分鐘。
